suggested_requirements.text: The XS shall provide registration of XML terms, tags, and structures.
The XS shall provide design capabilities for XML schemas.
The XS shall provide generation and consumption capabilities for XML documents.
The XS shall allow producers to receive XML registry forms.
The XS shall allow producers to submit metadata and related information resource artifacts.
The XS shall allow producers to notify changes in information resources.
The XS shall allow users to download the Information Resource Submittal Package.
The XS shall allow users to submit metadata via an on-line interactive process.
The XS shall allow users to submit metadata via an off-line interactive batch process.
The XS shall parse submitted XML Registry specification forms.
The XS shall populate the XML Registry database.
The XS shall allow modification of specified terms, definitions of metadata, and status of information resources.
The XS shall provide a capability to post planned changes to a registry.
The XS shall allow users to view XML tags via a tree/hierarchy structure or tabular format.
The XS shall allow users to search for specific XML tags.
The XS shall allow users to search for all tags of a given subscriber or author.
The XS shall provide capabilities to download XML tags or other selected information resources.
The XS shall catalog entities and attributes within servers to enable browsing, searching, and retrieving of data related to XML sources.
The XS shall process ANSI standard SQL as specified in FIPS PUB 127-2.
The XS shall provide a capability to subscribe for notification of changes to Communities of Interest or Information Resources.
The XS shall allow managers to create and manage usernames and superusers.
The XS shall generate standard views of XML data.
The XS shall generate XML and schema documents.
The XS shall validate XML documents for conformance and well-formedness.
The XS shall provide standard APIs for registry services.
The XS shall provide standard APIs for data access services.
The XS shall interface with existing data elements of DBIF, DAC, and COTS RDBMS products.
In fixed mode, data management services shall be tunable by on-site personnel to adjust for varying workloads and database sizes.
Session time-out values shall be user-definable and resettable prior to initialization of a user session.
The XS shall have the ability to redefine or reset names of connect descriptors to database server instances.
The Registry software shall be portable and execute on COE-compliant platforms.
The XS software shall be delivered in accordance with DII COE guidelines.
The XS developer is responsible for software maintenance, support, and updates.
